newsitem.title: KENYA: Activity in the bourse increases, index drops.
newsitem.headline: Activity in the bourse increases, index drops.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index dipped further on Thursday, reflecting current bearish sentiment, brokers said.
The index dropped 4.38 points to stand at 3029.64.
Turnover was posted at 7.459 million shillings traded on 200,986 shares from 4.873 million shillings traded on 169,771 shares on Wednesday.
Barclays Bank eased 50 cents to close at 99, Diamond Trust moved 12,597 shares at 35.75 from 36, while Kenya Commercial Bank traded 8,098 shares at an unchanged 55.
"The financials at the moment are attractive because they are fairly liquid shares," a broker said. "They are easily available and easily disposable."
A broker said financials are normally recommended to short-term players who want to go in and out as they please.

Another broker said financials were an investor favourite because they hedged well against inflation. He added that with commercial lending rates in the range of 24-35 percent, investors believed they would make a profit all the time, or at worst just get what they originally invested.
Carbacid Investments announced a bonus issue of three shares for every five on Thursday. There was no trading in the share but brokers anticipated that prices would go up following the announcement.

Total turnover was boosted by 16,489 shares of Kenya Power & Lighting, traded at 117 from 116 on Wednesday. Foreign investors bought 5,000 shares of Sasini Tea & Coffee at 53 and 10,000 shares of Kenya Airways at 11.50.
